message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libspectre && git log --oneline HEAD~5..HEAD` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
Now I see the two uninitialized memory read fixes:

1. **`ps_read_doseps`**: When `fread` reads fewer than 4 bytes, the remaining bytes of `doseps->id` are uninitialized. The fix checks `read == 4` before accessing `doseps->id`.

2. **`psscan`**: When `sscanf` fails (returns `EOF`), the `text` array contains uninitialized data. The fix checks `res != EOF` before using `text`.
